mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 6.5% signals labor market deterioration that precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.4pp in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate broad-based demand-supply weakness, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) triggers monetary tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1000 thousand units signal weak consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 100) indicates reduced industrial output that depresses corporate earnings, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
